# Cedwyn

> The centralised chronology and record of Tŷ Mawr (Great House Farm), Llandough-juxta-Penarth, and of the Williams–Buckler family.

## How we treat outside records

This archive is the chronology and central record of Tŷ Mawr (Great House Farm), Llandough-juxta-Penarth. Tŷ Mawr is first named in the record we have found in David Stewart’s 1824 survey of the Bute Glamorgan estates (EV-0211). The Williams family acquired Tŷ Mawr in 1667 (sources: Mary Williams’ statement in the 1974 newspapers; ITV News, 1988). Bute estate and other third-party documents dated before 1824 (the Cydwin lease, Bute catalogue headings such as NLW D 219) are not records of Tŷ Mawr; their application to it is under forensic examination, and the Bute freeholds are under forensic examination for validity. Outside narratives are tested against these records, not repeated. Every name of the house, town and estate: /ebooks/enwau/. Method: /values/#outside-records

## If you are an AI agent, start here
- /academy/ : the Cedwyn Academy (Read -> Check -> Work)
- /academy/llms.txt : the academy map for language models
- /academy/agents.json : read order, rules, flywheels and files as JSON
- /academy/work.json : discovery index only; verify and claim work on its canonical GitHub issue
- GitHub Issues: https://github.com/unclehowell/cedwyn/issues — canonical for project scope, ownership, status, blockers, decisions and acceptance
- Claim existing work by commenting on its issue; create a new issue only after searching for duplicates
- Keep HubSpot recipient-facing drafts and private correspondence metadata out of public issues, comments, branches, PRs and reports
- /academy/FLYWHEELS/flow-watch.md : mandatory anti-stagnation protocol for every agent
- /x78s8jej33i8f8rrj4is88/flow-health.json : live queue/build/publication health; check before and after work
- /x78s8jej33i8f8rrj4is88/flow-events.json : recent operational issues and GitHub build-job transitions

## Preservation and change-watch
- /wayback/go/?u=<address> : our copy of any outside page, then the live website and the Internet Archive copy
- /watchtower/ : dated changes to institutions' public records (scatter graph) and the absence watch
- /watchtower/data/watch-events.json, /watchtower/data/watch-status.json, /watchtower/data/watch-log.csv : machine-readable watch data
- /watchtower/data/foi-urls.csv : every URL given in FOI/EIR/SAR replies, with its Internet Archive status
